stem.text: Find the interval of convergence of the power series \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{\left(x - 4\right)^{n}}{4^{n} n} \). Use the ratio test for the interior and justify the behaviour at each endpoint.

answer_key.label: The interval of convergence is \( 0 \le x < 8 \).

worked_solution.text: For the ratio test, form \( \left|\frac{\frac{\left(x - 4\right)^{n+1}}{4^{n+1} (n+1)}}{\frac{\left(x - 4\right)^{n}}{4^{n} n}}\right| \).
The series converges when \( \frac{\left|x - 4\right|}{4} < 1 \), that is \( \left|x - 4\right| < 4 \), so \( 0 < x < 8 \).

At \( x = 8 \) the series is \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{n} \), which diverges by the p-series test, since it is a multiple of a p-series with \( p = 1 \le 1 \). At \( x = 0 \) the series is \( \sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{n} \), which converges by the alternating series test, since its terms alternate and their sizes decrease to 0.
The interval of convergence is \( 0 \le x < 8 \).

options.label: The interval of convergence is \( 0 < x < 8 \).
options.derivation: the endpoints left untested, so the open interval from the ratio test reported as the answer
